neighbours.label: the word-start piece ' D' opening a capitalised name, title or sentence (D-oodle, D-abbling, D-ervishes), with the rest of the word still to come; not other capital letters
fire: The puzzle apps she liked best were Sudoku, Wordle, Doodlers Quest and Tetris.
Goblins are sly and cowardly. Dwarves hold a grudge for centuries.
The nursery rhymes on the record were Humpty, Jack Sprat, Dillydallying Dan and Bo Peep.
Tonight's cartoon line-up: Rugrats, Hey Arnold, Dweebs in Space and Recess.
Roses need pruning in March. Daffodils need almost nothing at all.
The pub quiz teams were called Brainstorm, Quizzly Bears, Dunces United and Trivia Newton.
Her gym playlist had tracks named Sprint, Burn, Dumbbells at Dawn and Cooldown.
Wizards cast from afar. Dervishes of the desert fight up close.
quiet: The puzzle apps she liked best were Sudoku, Wordle, Scribblers Quest and Tetris.
Goblins are sly and cowardly. Giants hold a grudge for centuries.
The nursery rhymes on the record were Humpty, Jack Sprat, Shillyshallying Sam and Bo Peep.
Tonight's cartoon line-up: Rugrats, Hey Arnold, Geeks in Space and Recess.
Roses need pruning in March. Tulips need almost nothing at all.
The pub quiz teams were called Brainstorm, Quizzly Bears, Fools United and Trivia Newton.
Her gym playlist had tracks named Sprint, Burn, Kettlebells at Dawn and Cooldown.
Wizards cast from afar. Berserkers of the north fight up close.

notes: Card: ' D' x13, ' d', Cyrillic and Arabic d-pieces. Probes: 'Doodle Jump' 0.78, list item 'Dabbling Ducks' 0.79, sentence-initial 'Dervishes' 0.76, 'the Dwarves' 0.30, 'Dukes' 0.26; mid-sentence common words 'Dazzled' 0.10, 'Dandelions' 0.07, 'Dachshund' 0.00. So the piece alone is not enough; the name/title position seems to matter. Tokenisation of the test words checked ([' D', ...]).
